messages:
elaine.j: FYI auditor asked for a compact bundle showing recent RBAC changes, KMS rotation evidence, and the incident triage notes for CVE-2026-0421. Need to assemble by EOD tomorrow.

sam.r: Can you paste the auditor's exact checklist? makes it easier to map artifacts to controls.

auditor_tom: Hi — what we need: 1) list of role bindings changed in the past 90 days with justification, 2) KMS key rotation records (timestamps + operator), 3) proof that the incident response runbook was followed for CVE-2026-0421 (timeline + playbook run logs), 4) relevant audit-log exports showing privileged actions. Prefer CSV + screenshots where applicable.

elaine.j: Thanks Tom. Main asks map to SOC2: CC6 (access control), CC7 (change mgmt), and evidence for our incident response playbook.

maya.infra: For RBAC changes we can export k8s RoleBinding events and IAM policy change history. Quick command for clusters: 

```bash
kubectl get events -n kube-system --field-selector involvedObject.kind=RoleBinding -o json > /tmp/rbac-events.json
```

maya.infra: For cloud IAM (GCP): use audit logs filter: 

```bash
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND timestamp>"2025-12-01"' --project=redwood-prod --format=json > /tmp/iam-policy-changes.json
```

ken-oncall: I can grab the KMS rotation records. Our KMS is a mix of cloud KMS + HSM-managed keys. For AWS CMKs: 

```bash
aws kms list-keys --region us-west-2 --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id {} --region us-west-2
```

ken-oncall: Also will pull CloudKMS key versions and rotation timestamps for GCP keys.

sam.r: For the incident runbook proof, we have the oncall timeline and the incident run logs in /var/logs/incidents/cve-2026-0421/. We should include the PagerDuty playbook run export and the postmortem stub that shows actions taken.

elaine.j: Auditor wants justification for each RBAC change — link to PR or ticket and approver. We should include the PR number and change diff snapshot.

maya.infra: I'll script a little export to join rolebinding events with PR metadata (we store PR ID in the k8s change annotation). Example join hack: 

```python
# pseudo
import json, csv
events=json.load(open('/tmp/rbac-events.json'))
# extract annotation: events[i]['metadata']['annotations']['change.pr']
# output csv with rolebinding, namespace, pr, approver, timestamp
```

auditor_tom: CSVs + a README that maps each file to a control is perfect. Also need hash of each file (sha256) for integrity proof.

ken-oncall: I'll run sha256sum on each artifact before upload and include checksums.txt.

evidence-bot: export job queued: evidence-bundle-redwood-1719876543. Expected size ~120MB. ETA 35m.

sam.r: One more ask from compliance team: show that logs are immutable for the last 90 days and where we store the snapshots (S3 bucket with retention). Can we include the S3 lifecycle and bucket policy?

maya.infra: Yes — bucket policy + object lock status. Command: 

```bash
aws s3api get-bucket-versioning --bucket redwood-compliance-archives
aws s3api get-object-lock-configuration --bucket redwood-compliance-archives
```

elaine.j: Action items: 1) ken: KMS rotation exports + checksums. 2) maya: RBAC/PR join csv + bucket policies. 3) sam: incident logs + timeline + PD export. 4) I'll draft README to map files to SOC2 controls and include hashes. Delivery: EOD tomorrow.

ken-oncall: on it. uploading partials to s3://redwood-evidence/1719876543/partials/ in ~30m.

maya.infra: started RBAC export now. will post sample csv when ready.

sam.r: pulling incident logs, will scrub PII and include redacted timeline.

elaine.j: Thanks all. auditor_tom — can you confirm if screenshots of console evidence are needed or just exports?

auditor_tom: Exports are preferred. Screenshots okay if a particular UI-only artifact. Otherwise exports + hashes are sufficient. Thanks.

ken-oncall: partial upload done: s3://redwood-evidence/1719876543/partials/kms-rotation-2026-03-20.json (sha256: 3a7f...b2c4).

maya.infra: sample RBAC CSV uploaded to same path. attaching snippet: 

```
rolebinding,namespace,pr,approver,timestamp
editors-binding,product,PR#4219,maya.infra,2026-03-12T15:14:02Z
admin-binding,infra,PR#4190,ken-oncall,2026-02-28T09:02:11Z
```

sam.r: incident timeline exported and scrubbed. uploading to s3 now.

elaine.j: Great — I'm going to start assembling README + control mapping doc. Will ping when bundle ready for auditor. :thumbsup:

evidence-bot: export job complete. bundle: s3://redwood-evidence/1719876543/redwood-audit-bundle-1719876543.zip (size 118MB). Checksums file included.

auditor_tom: Received. We'll review and follow up with any gaps by EOD Friday. Thanks team.

elaine.j: Closing loop — please keep this thread for any post-upload clarifications.
